lead.event: IDX removes high-shareholding-concentration stocks from boards and index evaluations
lead.headline: IDX schedules HSC stock removals from boards and index evaluations, with 346 board exits
lead.blurb: Under the revised test, a stock is classified as high shareholding concentration (HSC) when its 10 largest shareholders collectively own at least 92.5%, with the previous Rp5 trillion market-cap threshold and Price Impact Ratio parameter dropped. IDX announced 4 Acceleration, 233 Development and 109 Main Board constituents exiting. The changes take effect on 30 November for boards and 1 December for index evaluations. HSC stocks have been excluded from the IHSG calculation since 13 November, IDX President Director Jeffrey Hendrik said.

earnings_guidance.event: BRIS reports Q3 2026 net profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: BRIS reports 10% net profit growth to Rp6.13 trillion through Q3 2026
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bank Syariah Indonesia lowered its NIM guidance to 5.3%-5.5% from above 5.5%. Financing revenue rose 4.35% to Rp23.20 trillion and fee-based income increased 46.14% to Rp2.58 trillion. Gross and net NPF improved to 1.80% and 0.35%, respectively.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 3 new articles with a new fact: Management lowered its NIM guidance to 5.3%-5.5% from above 5.5%.

earnings_guidance.event: ARCI reports nine-month 2026 net profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: ARCI reports nine-month net profit up 54.57% to US$108.94 million
earnings_guidance.blurb: Archi Indonesia shares rose 3.82% to Rp815 on 23 November. For the nine months ended 30 September, sales and operating revenue increased 39.70% to US$459.21 million.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: ARCI shares rose 3.82% to Rp815 on 23 November 2026.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: IDX sets BMAS theoretical share price after its rights issue
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: IDX sets BMAS theoretical share price at Rp418 after rights issue
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Bank Kasikorn Indonesia's 655:104 rights issue gives holders 104 rights to buy new shares for every 655 held, at Rp350 each. The adjusted price applies to trading on 24 November. BMAS plans to issue up to 2.87 billion shares to raise around Rp1 trillion for working capital and increased credit distribution.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: ADHI notifies a potential delay in bond interest payments
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: ADHI flags potential delay in Rp60.82 billion bond interest
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Adhi Karya told KSEI and the exchange its 18th interest installment on 2022 Series B and C bonds, due 24 November, may be delayed. Bondholders rejected proposals to reschedule or split coupons at two meetings. ADHI will coordinate with trustee Bank Mega on another meeting as restructuring continues.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: BUAT plans an IPO offering of up to 534 million shares
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BUAT plans IPO of up to 534 million shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Bumi Atsiri Prima is offering the new shares at Rp135–Rp190 each, targeting up to Rp101.46 billion. It plans to use all proceeds for working capital, mainly to buy patchouli oil, nutmeg oil and massoia bark oil.

deals_control.event: TBIG signs agreement to acquire EDOTCO Infrastruktur Indonesia
deals_control.headline: TBIG signs agreement to acquire 100% of EDOTCO Infrastruktur Indonesia
deals_control.blurb: Tower Bersama signed the SPA on 23 November with Axiata Group, EDOTCO Group and EDOTCO Malaysia. Completion remains subject to conditions precedent, and the transaction value has not been disclosed.

deals_control.event: Pikatan Baru becomes a major TMPO shareholder through an interim stock dividend

deals_control.blurb: Pikatan Baru received 107.83 million shares at an execution price of Rp151 each, effective 18 November. It previously held no TMPO shares or voting rights.
